description: PORTAL — one candidate/official's standing across every race you model them in. Give a {name} (and optional {party} to disambiguate); it finds all their appearances across your sims, builds each sim's impact report,…

candidate_id.description: Optional precise selector (the local roster id, e.g. "C1") to pick ONE candidate when a same-name same-party pair can't be split by {party} alone — take it from an ambiguous match's candidate_id/disambiguator.

name.description: The candidate/official's name as it appears in your rosters (case-insensitive).

party.description: Optional party (D/R/I/…) to disambiguate same-named candidates.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: candidate_standing
